commonPrompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one HIGH-FIDELITY DESIGN HANDOFF BOARD for Rayburst Connect, grouping only the requested related screens or component samples into a clean landscape 3:2 canvas. This is one board in a small reference set, not a giant poster of everything. Reference 1 is the user-approved delicate lightweight popup; reference 2 is the matching options page. Preserve this exact family: small regular system sans-serif, white surfaces, pale neutral gray surroundings/sidebar, thin gray outline icons, sparse hairlines, Electric Purple #7B3ED1 only for selected navigation, on switches and a few principal actions. Reproduce the small angular Rayburst lightning logo accurately. Do NOT amplify font weight, icon size, radii or purple coverage when creating multiple screens. Main text 13-14px regular at logical 420px popup width, metadata12px, settings headings20px medium at logical1000px page width. Normal text remains readable; no microscopic explanatory paragraphs. No glass, blur, thick outlines, huge statistics, colorful cards, nested cards, decorative gradients or oversized empty-state illustrations. Tiny English captions OUTSIDE frames identify each case; UI text INSIDE frames is simplified Chinese. Equal gutters and clean alignment, no arrows between panels except when explicitly needed. Crop settings to the relevant pane instead of repeating full chrome. Straight-on flat software pixels. Avoid adding nonexistent features.

boards.title: Popup states
boards.description: Interception off, disconnected, authentication error, and empty discovery.
boards.prompt:
Arrange FOUR COMPACT 420x280 popup states in a two-by-two grid. All have the same small logo Rayburst Connect and gear header, and text tabs 概览 / 媒体. Preserve light spacious rows like reference.
Upper-left caption "Interception off": header tiny green dot 已连接; overview tab; 接管下载 switch OFF, but live speeds 下载24.8MB/s 上传128KB/s and 进行中3 等待中1 已停止8 remain. Footer tiny pause/play circles and purple text 打开Rayburst. This proves interception off does not stop existing tasks.
Upper-right "Disconnected": header gray dot 未连接; overview selected; body small text 无法连接 Rayburst, helper 请先启动桌面应用; modest button 启动Rayburst and text 连接设置. No speed zeros or connected badge.
Lower-left "Authentication error": header gray dot 未连接; overview; small muted red icon and 密钥不匹配, helper 请检查连接设置中的API密钥; buttons 连接设置 and 重试. No giant warning card, no 已连接 anywhere in this frame.
Lower-right "Empty discovery": header tiny green dot 已连接; 媒体 selected; hostname video.example.com; labelled 发现媒体 ON switch; small text 尚未发现媒体, helper 播放页面中的视频或音频后再试, modest text button 扫描页面. No redundant second scan action or huge icon.

boards.title: Media selection and handoff
boards.description: Video and live selection, uncertain receipt, submitted task, and player entry.
boards.prompt:
Create a landscape board with TWO medium-height popup forms on the left and middle, and a narrower right column with two short status samples and a small player-button sample. Do not shrink text to fit. Left caption "Video selection": matching brand header and tabs with 媒体 selected, back 媒体列表, title Design lecture, tiny HLS ·24:18. Four stacked labelled32px controls with6px label gap and18px group gaps: 清晰度 dropdown1080p; 音轨 dropdown英语 ·AAC; 字幕 dropdown简体中文; 保存格式 dropdownMP4. Footer small buttons取消 and开始下载; body remains inside the frame. Middle "Live selection": same form, title Live session, metadata HLS ·直播; 清晰度720p,音轨英语,字幕无,保存格式MKV, additional 录制时长 input0秒 with helper0表示持续录制，在Rayburst中结束. Footer取消 and开始录制. Only this final action filled purple, not every selector.
Right top "Receipt pending": quiet source title Design lecture, spinner 正在确认下载结果, subtitle1080p ·英语 ·MP4, text 检查状态. No new-download button; no failure claim.
Right middle "Task created": small check icon 已在Rayburst中创建下载, subtitle same selection, purple text 打开Rayburst. Do not say completed download.
Right bottom "Player entry": ONLY a tiny white horizontal overlay control using logo18px + 下载·Rayburst and separate close×, with a small white source popover beneath showing Design lecture and HLS. No simulated real video or website screenshot.

boards.prompt:

Each pane white, at least roughly360 logicalpx wide, 13px regular Chinese text, small restrained section headings. Outside captions Download, Rules, Maintenance.
